### generate

`int[] generate(Shape shape, int width, int height, double size, double left, double top, double range)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the RGB pixels of the field of that size, at that glyph size in pixels per em, from that top-left corner in ems, with distances mapped over that range in pixels.
